title: Localization accessibility of Theorem summod5
statement: The localization method is applied to the functions and congruences described above, with $L_{\alpha}=L_{\alpha}^{(0)}+L_{\alpha}^{(1)}$ lying in $\mathcal{M}(\mathrm{X}_0(10))$ and satisfying $L_{\alpha}\equiv 0\pmod{5^{\alpha}}$. **Localization accessibility claim.** Theorem summod5 is accessible via the localization method. The authors have not yet proved this application of localization, but believe it is accessible; the claim concerns a possible proof of the relation between the two congruence families.
source_name: Frank G. Garvan, James A. Sellers and Nicolas Allen Smoot, “Old Meets New: Connecting Two Infinite Families of Congruences Modulo Powers of 5 for Generalized Frobenius Partition Functions”, arXiv:2402.18509 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.18509

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2024).
